FIELDS.NAME: Bright Futures Child Care Center
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Sarah Johnson, Center Director, phone: (555) 555-1234, email: sarah.johnson@brightfutures.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Bright Futures Child Care Center is dedicated to providing a safe and nurturing environment for children aged six weeks to five years. Our operations are grounded in state-mandated guidelines and best practices in early childhood education. We maintain a low staff-to-child ratio to ensure individualized attention and support, fostering each child's social, emotional, and cognitive development through structured activities, play, and exploration.

Our facility is equipped with secure entry systems and child-proofed spaces to guarantee the safety of all children in our care. We conduct regular safety drills, and our emergency procedures are well-documented and communicated to staff and parents. The center emphasizes a hygienic and healthy environment by adhering to strict sanitation protocols and food allergy management guidelines.

Bright Futures is committed to staff training, ensuring our educators are certified in child development and emergency response, and all staff members undergo comprehensive background checks. We prioritize strong communication with parents, providing regular updates and maintaining thorough documentation of attendance and incidents. Our center is positioned in a welcoming neighborhood, allowing us to focus entirely on the wellbeing and growth of the children and reassuring parents of a secure and enriching environment.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On September 15, 2022, a minor incident occurred when a child tripped during playtime, resulting in a small scrape on the knee. The total cost incurred for treatment was $150. The incident was addressed promptly, and parents were notified. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fenced play area with monitored entry points and staff patrols during outdoor activities.
